name: Property Sales Report
purpose: Calculates median sale price per suburb per month

inputs.sale_price: Price the property sold for, in Australian dollars
inputs.property_type: Type of property, such as house, unit or townhouse
inputs.sale_method: How the sale went, such as sold at auction, sold before auction or passed in
inputs.agency_name: Real estate agency that handled the sale
inputs.land_size_sqm: Size of the land the property sits on, in square meters
inputs.buyer_name: Name of the person who bought the property
inputs.stamp_duty: Stamp duty the buyer paid on the sale
